structure: Grade-level social studies standards (HCSS III). u1 = grade title; first table = 'Grades K-2 Inquiry Standards' (Anchor Standards 1-5, codes SS.K-2.n.m; anchor standard names split across rows of C1; Anchor Standard 3 shows 'Begins in grades 3-5' placeholders in K-2); then numbered Themes. Each Theme: header row (Theme N + title), 'Sample Compelling Questions' row (bullets), 4-column table header (Anchor Standard / Topic / Content Standard / Sample Content/Concepts), 'The student demonstrates an understanding of' / 'Therefore, the student is able to' sub-header, then rows: C1 discipline (Civics/History/Geography/Economics) followed by Anchor Standard number and name in later C1 rows, C2 topic, C3 'Content Standard SS.K.t.a.n.theme.anchor.n' statement, C4 bullet sample content/concepts.
